title: DecisionRecord
description: A sealed, hash-chained pre-execution authorization decision (DRP protocol). record_hash = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON payload (all properties except record_hash, sorted keys, compact separators (',', ':'), no type coercion). Per-agent chain: prev_hash equals the previous decision's record_hash for the same agent_id. The FIRST record of an agent establishes that agent's origin: 64 zeros means unanchored genesis; any other value is an external provenance anchor (e.g. the head of a prior export). Verifiers MUST verify continuity from the origin and MUST report anchored agents; anchor authenticity is attested out of band. The chain link is INSIDE the hashed payload: signatures over record_hash therefore cover history, making silent re-ordering impossible. DRP 0.2: payload shape, canonicalization, record_hash, and chain linkage are unchanged from 0.1. Records additionally carry a commitments object holding digests of the same canonical bytes under multiple hash algorithms, and the signature is over SHA3-256(canonical(commitments)) rather than over record_hash. This makes hash-algorithm migration possible without re-accessing payloads, which digest-only retention has made unavailable. See spec/drp-0.2/COMMITMENTS.md.

protocol_version.description: DRP protocol version this record conforms to.

parent_decision.description: decision_id of this agent's previous decision; null for the first record in an agent chain.

triggered_by.description: Which precedence rule produced the decision, e.g. invariant, authorization, drift, baseline.

arguments_digest.description: SHA-256 of canonical action arguments. Raw arguments are never stored.

outcome.description: Always pending on a sealed decision. Execution results are separate ExecutionEvent records; decisions are never mutated.

edges.description: Graph edges produced for decisions today: follows (target = parent_decision).

request_id.description: Optional link to the originating ActionRequest. Populated when the caller supplies a request identifier; null otherwise.

commitments.description: Digests of the identical octet string canonical(payload), one per algorithm. Verifiers MUST recompute every entry present, not only the one they prefer. sha-256 MUST equal record_hash. The signature is over SHA3-256(canonical(commitments)).
